title: Run assisted CompCheck on original AWS DateUtils bytecode
description: The two unassisted callsite-only CompCheck runs both failed to build AWS offline and wrote empty contexts. Repeat both knowledge treatments on the same stock production c15-2 using the actual original DateUtils.class, independently hash-matched to the AWS calibration, in Maven target/classes. The case-specific preparation supplies authentic binary dependencies, never knowledge context, API return values, test fixtures or expected answers. Record context size, matching result, generated test counts and the first unsupported step.
expected: Each treatment records its scoped stock outcome on bytecode from the actual old revision, including an open result if the workflow cannot reach generated JUnit validation.

resources.notes: The baseline configures a 60-second EvoSuite search with a 4 GiB heap on a matching context. The paired cold run took 24 seconds including preparation and 2.82 GiB peak.

steps.name: Compare assisted original bytecode with and without AWS issue 233 knowledge
